$comment: Copy for the smart-scheduling rollout, written by the rollout-copywriter agent from input/smart-scheduling/feature.md.
headline: Book meetings [right inside] the conversation
intro: Smart Scheduling turns "what time works for you?" into a booked meeting in one reply. Open times from your team's calendars appear right in the text thread, customers pick a slot, and the meeting is created, confirmed and reminded automatically. The result: fewer lost leads, less back-and-forth, and more time for the conversations that close deals.
lead: Smart Scheduling books meetings inside the text thread: offer open times, sync your team's calendars, confirm and remind automatically, and set rules per inbox.

hero.alt: A text conversation where the customer picks one of three suggested meeting times, surrounded by team avatars

sections.title: Offer open times without leaving the thread
sections.body: Click Suggest times in the composer to drop three open slots into your reply. Customers answer with a number or a tap, and the meeting is booked on the spot, with no links to open and no forms to fill in.
sections.alt: The message composer with a Suggest times menu inserting three time slots into a reply

sections.title: Connect your team's calendars once
sections.body: Link Google or Microsoft calendars, set working hours, buffers and meeting length, and let round-robin hand every booking to the next available rep, so availability is always accurate and evenly shared.
sections.alt: Scheduling settings with connected calendars, working hours and a round-robin toggle

sections.title: Confirmations and reminders on autopilot
sections.body: The moment a slot is picked, the customer gets a confirmation, with reminders 24 hours and 1 hour before. Track every meeting as Booked, Reminded, Rescheduled or No-show from one list.
sections.alt: A list of upcoming meetings with Booked and Reminded statuses and a reminder message preview

sections.title: Booking rules that fit each inbox
sections.body: Give every inbox its own meeting types, availability and pre-booking questions, from a 30-minute demo to a 45-minute onboarding, so each team books the right meeting with the right details.
sections.alt: Inbox booking rules showing Demo and Onboarding meeting types with durations

sections.title: Reschedule with a single text
sections.body: Customers will be able to reply "reschedule" and get fresh times straight away, keeping the meeting on the calendar instead of letting it slip through the cracks.
sections.alt: A customer replying reschedule and receiving new suggested times

seo.title: Smart Scheduling: Book Meetings Over Text | Acme Cloud
seo.description: Smart Scheduling books meetings inside the text conversation: suggest open times, sync team calendars, and send confirmations and reminders automatically.

faq.a: Smart Scheduling lets customers book a meeting without leaving the text conversation. The rep or the AI assistant offers open times from the team's calendars, and the customer picks one by replying.

faq.q: Which calendars does Smart Scheduling work with?
faq.a: It connects to Google and Microsoft calendars in Settings > Scheduling, where you also set working hours, buffer time and meeting length. Round-robin gives each meeting to the next available rep.

faq.q: Are confirmations and reminders sent automatically?
faq.a: Yes. When the customer picks a time, the meeting is created and a confirmation is sent, then reminders go out 24 hours and 1 hour before it.

faq.q: Can each inbox have its own booking rules?
faq.a: Yes. Each inbox can have its own meeting types, such as a 30-minute demo or a 45-minute onboarding, its own availability, and the questions asked before booking.
Not yet: rescheduling by text is coming soon. Customers will be able to reply "reschedule" to get new times.
